# AGENTS.md — slop-seattle

A browser-based city simulation built with three.js, WebGPURenderer and TSL. The README and code still describe "Slop New York" and Manhattan.

## Do not edit

- `js/nyc-geodata.js`: generated by `tools/build-geodata.mjs`.
- `js/building-geodata.js`, `js/building-geodata.bin.gz`: generated by `tools/build-buildings.py`.
- `js/tree-geodata.js`, `js/tree-geodata.bin.gz`: generated by `tools/build-trees.py`.
- `js/subway-geodata.js`: generated by `tools/build-subway-entrances.mjs`.
- `tools/data/*.json`: third-party source extracts (NYC Open Data, MTA, OpenStreetMap) under their own licenses.
